description: Bare except Exception without logging
remediation: Add logger.warning or logger.debug to all except blocks

description: asyncio.run() inside async function blocks event loop
remediation: Use await instead of asyncio.run(); use asyncio.sleep instead of time.sleep

description: TODO without ticket reference or expiration date
remediation: Add ticket reference and expiration date to all TODO/FIXME comments

description: SELECT * in migration file
remediation: Replace SELECT * with explicit column list

evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml — no pip-audit, trivy, bandit, snyk, or dependabot step

description: CORS defaults allow localhost origins
remediation: Set default CORS_ORIGINS to empty string; require explicit configuration

description: Business logic in module router
remediation: Extract business logic to domain service; router should only call service

description: Security events may not be logged at WARNING+
evidence: backend/middleware/database_security.py:44,186 — log_security_event called but some exception paths don't log

description: No automated test for function length
evidence: No test file checks function length; auth_service.py has functions >1000 lines

description: No automated test for magic numbers
evidence: backend/infrastructure/security/auth.py:26 — LOGIN_FAIL_MAX = 5 (hardcoded); no test checks for unnamed numeric constants

description: Allowlist has 20+ entries with future removal dates

description: No CI step runs pip-audit despite test referencing it
evidence: backend/tests/architecture/test_precommit_pip_audit.py exists but .github/workflows/ci.yml has no pip-audit step

description: Rate limit allows requests when Valkey is unreachable
evidence: backend/infrastructure/valkey/cache.py — some rate-limit paths return True when Valkey is down

description: print() used in production code
remediation: Replace print() with structlog logger
